id: 14_HEALTH AND SAFETY QUIZ Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition H
title: 健康与安全综合十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/14_HEALTH AND SAFETY QUIZ Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition H.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/14_HEALTH AND SAFETY QUIZ Safety Quiz Questions & Answers Safety Quiz Competition H/src.py

points.K5: 单位要保障人人安全健康
points.S2: 实验室门口的安全信息牌

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一面贴满安全标志的墙前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a wall covered with colorful safety signs and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天来一场健康与安全综合十问。

shots.scene: 一行图标：放大镜、四色标志、人群、火焰
shots.prompt_en: A row of simple icons: a magnifying glass, safety signs in four colors, a group of people and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 事故、标志、责任、危害、灭火都有。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊，小研带着新同学阿杰参观
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory building corridor, the female graduate student shows the young male student around.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚进课题组，小研带他熟悉实验楼。

shots.scene: 阿杰看着墙上各种颜色的标志发呆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares at many colorful safety signs on the wall, puzzled.
shots.narration: 满墙的标志，阿杰看得一头雾水。

shots.scene: 小研笑着拿出题卡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and takes out a stack of blank question cards.
shots.narration: 小研说：边走边答题，一会儿就懂。

shots.scene: 王老师在空白事故记录本上写记录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator writes in a blank accident record book.
shots.narration: 第一题：为什么每起事故都要调查记录？

shots.scene: 法规书、执法人员、档案三张卡片打问号
shots.prompt_en: Three cards: a law book, an inspector badge and a file box, each with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不只是为了守规定、应付检查、留档案。

shots.scene: 找到原因后，同样的事故图标被盾牌挡住
shots.prompt_en: After a magnifier finds a cause, a repeated accident icon is blocked by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是找到原因，防止类似事故再发生。

shots.scene: 四个蓝色圆形标志：安全帽、护目镜、口罩、耳罩
shots.prompt_en: Four blue circular mandatory signs with white pictograms: a helmet, safety goggles, a dust mask and ear muffs. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：蓝色圆形、白色图案的标志？

shots.scene: 阿杰戴上护目镜，站在标志下
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles under a blue mandatory sign on the lab door.
shots.narration: 答案是指令：这里必须戴相应防护用品。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着蓝色圆形
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blue circle shape.
shots.narration: 国内叫指令标志，意思是必须这样做。

shots.scene: 一排黄色三角警告标志：有毒、易燃、腐蚀、激光
shots.prompt_en: A row of yellow triangular warning signs with black pictograms: toxic, flammable, corrosive and laser. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：黄色三角、黑色图案的标志？

shots.scene: 阿杰在标志前停下脚步，认真看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops in front of a yellow warning sign and reads it carefully.
shots.narration: 答案是警告：附近有危险，要小心。

shots.scene: 欣欣举手示意不要贸然前进
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a paw in a stop gesture.
shots.narration: 没弄清危险，不要贸然往前走。

shots.scene: 绿色方形标志：紧急出口、集合点
shots.prompt_en: Green rectangular signs with white pictograms: an emergency exit with a running person and an assembly point. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：绿色方形、白色图案的标志？

shots.scene: 小研指着出口标志，阿杰顺着箭头看去
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student points at an exit sign and the young male student follows its arrow with his eyes.
shots.narration: 答案是提示：告诉你出口和集合点在哪。

shots.scene: 绿色标志旁有人不戴防护的图标打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person taking off goggles under a green sign, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 看到绿色，不代表这里没有危险。

shots.section_title: 单位要保障人人安全健康
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一本法律书旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a closed blank law book.
shots.narration: 第五题：单位在法律上必须做什么？
overlay: 单位要保障人人安全健康

shots.section_title: 单位要保障人人安全健康
shots.scene: 明亮装饰、安全帽彩色、小册子三张卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three cards crossed out: bright decorations, colorful personal helmets and a booklet. No people.
shots.narration: 不是装修漂亮，也不是发彩色安全帽。

shots.section_title: 单位要保障人人安全健康
shots.scene: 盾牌护住一群人的图标
shots.prompt_en: A large shield protecting a group of person icons. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是保障所有人员的安全与健康。

shots.section_title: 单位要保障人人安全健康
shots.scene: 两本法律书和图章
shots.prompt_en: Two closed blank law books with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 国内依据安全生产法、职业病防治法。

shots.scene: 办公室里，温度计图标和坐着打字的人
shots.prompt_en: In an office, a thermometer icon floats beside the female graduate student typing at a desk.
shots.narration: 第六题：坐着办公，温度有没有要求？

shots.scene: 太冷的人发抖、手指僵硬的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person shivering with stiff fingers. No people.
shots.narration: 太冷手指僵硬，容易出错受伤。

shots.scene: 一本书和图章
shots.prompt_en: A closed blank book with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原题是英国数值，国内按职业卫生标准。

shots.scene: 老周、小研、阿杰、老李、王老师站成一排
shots.prompt_en: The older man, the female graduate student, the young male student, the facility engineer and the safety administrator stand in a row.
shots.narration: 第七题：实验室安全由谁负责？

shots.scene: 每个人头顶都亮起一个小盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A small shield lights up above each person's head.
shots.narration: 答案是每一个人，不管是谁派来的。

shots.scene: 老李这样的外来维修人员也亮起盾牌
shots.prompt_en: A visiting repair worker icon also gets a small shield. No people.
shots.narration: 外来维修、施工人员也一样。

shots.scene: 实验台上：电线、酸瓶、热板，都发出警示光
shots.prompt_en: On a lab bench, a cable, an acid bottle and a hot plate each glow with a warning light. No people.
shots.narration: 第八题：什么是危害？

shots.scene: 欣欣点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods.
shots.narration: 答案是：任何可能造成伤害的东西。

shots.scene: 骰子图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A dice icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出错的可能性，那是风险，不是危害。

shots.scene: 几种灭火器并排
shots.prompt_en: Several fire extinguishers of different types stand side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：灭火器有几种？

shots.scene: 原题答案四种的卡片
shots.prompt_en: A card with four extinguisher icons and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 原题答四种，这是英国的分法。

shots.scene: 灭火器标签上画着不同火灾类别的图标
shots.prompt_en: Extinguisher labels showing different fire class pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 国内按灭火剂和适用火灾类别来选。

shots.scene: 实验台上一个小火苗，阿杰拿起灭火器
shots.prompt_en: A small flame on a lab bench; the young male student picks up a fire extinguisher.
shots.narration: 第十题：动手灭火前，先问哪几个问题？

shots.scene: 黑烟图标
shots.prompt_en: A dark smoke cloud icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 我能避开有毒烟气吗？

shots.scene: 出口箭头在阿杰背后
shots.prompt_en: An exit arrow behind the young male student, who stands between the fire and the door.
shots.narration: 我背后有逃生路线吗？

shots.scene: 灭火器标签和火焰类型对照
shots.prompt_en: The extinguisher label compared with the type of burning material. No people.
shots.narration: 我手里的灭火器对路吗？

shots.scene: 欣欣举手：有一个不确定就撤离
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the exit door.
shots.narration: 有一个答不上来，就撤离报警。

shots.scene: 红色圆圈加斜杠的禁止标志：禁止烟火、禁止饮食
shots.prompt_en: Red circular prohibition signs with a diagonal bar: no smoking, no eating and drinking. No people.
shots.narration: 原片少了一类：红色禁止标志。

shots.scene: 四类标志排成一排：红、黄、蓝、绿
shots.prompt_en: Four types of safety signs in a row: red prohibition, yellow warning, blue mandatory and green safe condition. No people.
shots.narration: 禁止、警告、指令、提示，一共四类。

shots.scene: 王老师检查一块褪色的标志并更换
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator replaces a faded safety sign on the wall.
shots.narration: 标志按国家标准设置，坏了及时换。

shots.section_title: 实验室门口的安全信息牌
shots.scene: 实验室门口挂着安全信息牌，上面是图标
shots.prompt_en: A safety information card hangs beside a laboratory door, showing hazard pictograms and a phone icon.
shots.narration: 实验室门口，都挂着安全信息牌。
overlay: 实验室门口的安全信息牌

shots.section_title: 实验室门口的安全信息牌
shots.scene: 阿杰在门口停下看信息牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stops at the door and reads the information card.
shots.narration: 进门前看清：有什么危险，要戴什么。

shots.section_title: 实验室门口的安全信息牌
shots.scene: 信息牌上电话图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The phone icon on the information card lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，知道该找谁、打哪个电话。

shots.scene: 小研穿上保暖外套，走进冷室
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a warm coat and enters a cold room.
shots.narration: 冷室、冷库里做实验，要注意保暖。

shots.scene: 冷手指握着移液器，手腕红点
shots.prompt_en: Cold stiff fingers grip a pipette; a red glow on the wrist. No people.
shots.narration: 低温下手指不灵活，更容易劳损。

shots.scene: 小研戴保暖手套，分段出来休息
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wears thin warm gloves and steps out of the cold room to rest.
shots.narration: 戴合适手套，分段进出，别一待太久。

shots.scene: 冷室门内侧的开门把手，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A door handle on the inside of the cold room door, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 确认门能从里面打开，告诉同伴。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排图标前：眼睛、话筒、手掌、出口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands before four icons: an eye, a speech bubble, a raised palm and an exit.
shots.narration: 人人有责，也人人有权。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周询问实验的危险
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the older man about the hazards of an experiment.
shots.narration: 有权知道实验有哪些危险和防护。

shots.scene: 阿杰摇头拒绝不戴护目镜的要求
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shakes his head, refusing to work without goggles.
shots.narration: 违章指挥、冒险作业，可以拒绝。

shots.scene: 警报响起，阿杰停下手里的活撤离
shots.prompt_en: An alarm sounds and the young male student stops work and leaves through the exit.
shots.narration: 遇到紧急危险，可以停止作业撤离。

shots.scene: 小研弯腰驼背盯着很低的屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hunches over a low monitor at a desk, with red glows on her neck and wrists.
shots.narration: 整天在电脑前分析数据，颈腕会劳损。

shots.scene: 屏幕抬高到视线平齐，一臂距离
shots.prompt_en: The monitor is raised to eye level at about arm's length in front of her.
shots.narration: 屏幕上沿与视线平齐，离开一臂远。

shots.scene: 椅子调到脚平放地面，背靠椅背
shots.prompt_en: The chair is adjusted so her feet rest flat on the floor and her back is supported.
shots.narration: 椅子调到双脚着地，腰背有支撑。

shots.scene: 键盘鼠标靠近身体，手腕平直
shots.prompt_en: The keyboard and mouse are placed close to her body with straight wrists. No people.
shots.narration: 键盘鼠标放近，手腕保持平直。

shots.scene: 小研站起来远眺伸展
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands up, looks out the window and stretches.
shots.narration: 隔一会儿起身，远眺放松。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四色标志墙前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the wall of four-color safety signs.
shots.narration: 红禁止，黄警告，蓝指令，绿提示。

shots.scene: 放大镜和盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier icon and a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 调查事故为防再犯，安全人人有责。

shots.scene: 灭火器、烟雾、出口三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an extinguisher, smoke and an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火前先问三件事，不行就撤离。

shots.scene: 冷室门和电脑工位图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cold room door and an adjusted computer desk. No people.
shots.narration: 冷室注意保暖，工位调整舒适。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside a lab door with a safety information card.
shots.narration: 认得标志，懂得权利，安全常在！
